name: Natural Person Identification 2
definition: Identifies a natural person through identification number, name and domicile.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the natural person.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Indicates the name of the natural person.

Domicile.name: Domicile
Domicile.definition: Indicates the domicile of the natural person.
